ai_positioning.summary: Wiley acknowledges significant opportunities and risks from AI technologies. The company is actively exploring AI licensing revenue streams (generating $40M in FY2025, +74% YoY) while addressing potential disruption risks including market cannibalization, workforce displacement concerns, regulatory compliance costs, and data privacy challenges related to generative AI tool adoption.
evidence: AI license revenue of $40 million in FY2025 vs $23 million in FY2024
Explicit mention of leveraging AI technologies for business benefits, insights, and efficiencies
Recognition of risks: market disruption, legal/regulatory risks, content quality issues, workforce culture impact
Focus on responsible AI use with emphasis on data control and third-party technology governance
ai_positioning.source: 10-K Item 1 Business Risk Factors; MD&A Revenue Section

risks.title: Artificial Intelligence Disruption
risks.score_rationale: AI technologies present both opportunities and significant threats including market disruption, product cannibalization, regulatory uncertainty, content quality risks, and workforce displacement concerns. The 10-K extensively details these evolving and unpredictable risks.
risks.summary: Rapid evolution of AI and generative AI technologies could disrupt Wiley's markets, cannibalize existing products, create regulatory compliance costs, and impact workforce retention

risks.title: Cybersécurité
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K emphasizes the importance of cybersecurity oversight through the Audit Committee and CISO reporting. Given Wiley's digital-first business model (83% digital revenue) and content sensitivity, cybersecurity threats could significantly impact operations and reputation.
risks.summary: Cybersecurity risks are actively monitored with quarterly reporting to the Audit Committee, reflecting critical importance to the organization

risks.title: Concurrence
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in competitive publishing and education markets. AI technologies could increase competition, particularly from new entrants leveraging generative AI capabilities.
risks.summary: Increased competition in publishing and education sectors, potentially accelerated by AI-enabled market entrants

risks.title: Réputation
risks.score_rationale: AI-generated content quality issues, bias, or inaccuracy could damage brand reputation. Additionally, perceived misuse of generative AI could harm employee relations and customer trust.
risks.summary: Reputational risks from potential AI content quality issues, bias, or misuse, particularly if AI tools are perceived as displacing workers

risks.title: Régulation
risks.score_rationale: Emerging AI regulations (referenced FTC/DOJ involvement) present uncertain compliance costs and operational constraints. Regulatory landscape for AI is rapidly evolving and difficult to predict.
risks.summary: Emerging and evolving AI regulations could impose monitoring obligations and compliance costs on the company

risks.title: Géopolitique
risks.score_rationale: Wiley operates globally and faces geopolitical volatility affecting markets and regulations. International operations introduce currency and regulatory exposure.
risks.summary: Global operations expose the company to geopolitical risks affecting market access and regulatory compliance

risks.title: Litige
risks.score_rationale: AI technology use raises legal and ethical questions. Potential litigation risks from content misuse, data privacy violations, or regulatory non-compliance.
risks.summary: Emerging legal and ethical issues related to AI technology use and data governance could result in litigation
